text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear claim: \"I am against the driverless car\"","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states its position directly and leaves no doubt about the argument it will make."},{"evidence":"explains tired driver and needing to take over","quality":"reasoned support","description":"The essay gives a concrete chain of cause and effect to explain why driverless cars could be unsafe."},{"evidence":"\"Lets say their was an accident...\" and \"That person might get into a car crash\"","quality":"argument development","description":"The essay develops its main concern with a specific scenario rather than just repeating a general opinion."},{"evidence":"\"Even though the car might have all the sensors on it...\"","quality":"use of counterpoint","description":"The essay acknowledges a possible benefit or objection and then answers it to strengthen the argument."},{"evidence":"\"this is why i am against the driverless car\"","quality":"conclusion control","description":"The essay ends by tying its reasons back to the position in a clear closing statement."}]}
